checks.finding: All four tasks' Risk: high declarations match sentinel-surface scope per risk-classification-policy.md: T-001 (protected-file application runner, access-control/tamper-evidence surface), T-002/T-003 (the Lite/Full risk-upgrade decision gate, an access-control-like surface), T-004 (the post-implementation enforcement Gate turning full_upgrade_required/unmapped check-ids into blocking VERDICT: FAIL). None touches payment/physical-safety/regulated surfaces, so none is under- or over-classified to critical, and none is UI-copy/docs/test-only work mis-tagged high. Consistent with the prior attempt's persisted task-review PASS evidence for this same tasks.md content (provenance re-review, TYPE-H convergence) â no new finding basis.

T-004 (Risk: high, Status: Done) contains a self-contradiction in its own Done When section that leaves the required independent-review-verdict evidence unresolved. tasks.md's T-004 Done-When list item '[~] TDD evidence' states verbatim: 'An independent quality-gate verdict has not yet been recorded â QG delegation is held per main's own instruction... This bullet is not fully satisfied until that verdict lands.' This is the literal, load-bearing Done-When text for a high-risk task now marked Status: Done. A separate, earlier 'Quality-Gate Addendum' block (before the Goal/Scope/Done-When sections) claims an evaluator run (seq0329) recorded VERDICT: PASS and explicitly states 'Status is deliberately NOT set to Done by this addendum â that remains main's own decision,' but that addendum is not itself part of the Done When section and names no reviewer by name (only a run id), unlike T-001/T-002/T-003's Done-When TDD-evidence bullets, which each explicitly commit to 'a named second reviewer distinct from the implementing agent.' Because the Done When section's own governing checkbox for this exact evidence requirement is checked '[~]' (partial) and its own text asserts the requirement is not yet satisfied, while Status independently reads Done, a downstream implementer or quality gate cannot determine from this task's own Done When text whether the HIGH-CRITICAL-EVIDENCE bar (RedâGreen + a named independent review verdict) was actually met before Done was recorded. This is a TYPE-D check, not subject to the provenance re-review TYPE-H convergence suppression, and is not owned by precheck (which validates hashes/format only) or by any of reviewer A's listed checks (PREREQ-AC-IDS, BLOCKERS-FORMAT, REQ-COVERAGE, AC-COVERAGE, ORPHAN-TASK, ORPHAN-TEST, INITIAL-STATE, RISK-WORKFLOW-FORMAT, NO-DUPLICATE-AC, DEPENDENCY-COMPLETE, DEPENDENCY-CYCLE, SINGLE-CONCERN, OBSERVABLE-DONE, TRACEABILITY-SYNC), none of which examine high/critical evidentiary sufficiency. Failure mode: a Risk: high task's Done state is not traceable to unambiguous, internally consistent evidence text, which is exactly the hard-policy gap HIGH-CRITICAL-EVIDENCE exists to block.

Each of T-001..T-004 is one coherent unit scoped to a single file/skill edit (T-001: one new runner script; T-002: one script pair + policy doc; T-003: one skill file; T-004: one skill file, Step 2a+2b as a single coupled Process extension). Done-When bullet counts are 5 (T-001), 6 (T-002), 6 (T-003), 6 (T-004) â none exceeds eight. No task title implies multiple sequential design/implement/test phases beyond the uniform two-commit convention Global Constraints fixes for every task. No fragmentation pattern (no trio of single-function-edit tasks, no bare rename-only task). Consistent with the prior attempt's persisted task-review PASS evidence for this same decomposition (TYPE-H convergence) â no new finding basis.

Each functional task's Done-When/Scope cites acceptance criteria with explicit error-path coverage, not only happy-path: T-001 cites AC-031's exact-set/hash/post-copy contract (fixture list explicitly names payload-set-mismatch, hash-mismatch, control-file-miscounted, and post-copy-corruption fixtures); T-002 cites AC-027 (fragment fail-closed) and AC-028 (ineligible-with-no-reasons synthetic token); T-003 cites AC-019 plus the defense-in-depth companion fixture (ship-time recheck still Blocks when intake-time evaluation missed the component); T-004 cites AC-012 (schema-invalid Summary), AC-016 (unmapped check-id, reversed to FAIL not N/A), AC-026 (full_upgrade_required backstop), AC-030 (absent-Summary under active enforcement), and the NEW-01 negative fixtures (grammar-failing/`../`/symlink/single-runtime-member ids). No functional task is left with only happy-path acceptance criteria. Consistent with the prior attempt's persisted PASS evidence (TYPE-H convergence) â no new finding basis.

No suite's declared scope contradicts its stated test type. Consistent with the prior attempt's persisted PASS evidence (TYPE-H convergence) â no new finding basis.

All four Risk: high tasks carry an explicit `Rollback:` field: T-001 ('revert this task's two commits... a revert PR states explicitly whether an already-human-applied protected-file change... should also be hand-reverted'); T-002 and T-003 (near-identical: revert two commits, staged human-copy change is never applied directly, revert PR states whether an already-human-applied change should also be hand-reverted, and by whom); T-004 ('revert this task's commits... this is a direct edit â both commits land directly on the real lite-gate/SKILL.md path, no human-copy staging or apply step is needed').
